title: Custom Split-Grille Bar for Porsche 911 993
notes: Three STL files and a declared 355.934 x 140.000 x 18.805 mm envelope. Custom grille rather than an OEM replacement. Re-open the original Thingiverse record and confirm the exact Creative Commons version before importing. 2026-10-15: the original Thingiverse page (thing 4349486) was not read: www.thingiverse.com served its robots.txt behind a Cloudflare bot challenge (HTTP 403, 'Just a moment...') to both the page-reading tool and a plain HTTP client, so permission for automated agents could not be established and the thing page was not requested. The Internet Archive index lists a capture of that page dated 2023-09-28 (HTTP 200); it was not read, because the page-reading tool refuses web.archive.org. The CC-BY-NC-SA (no version) statement rests only on the secondary archive, so redistribution is set to unknown, as for every Renn 3D Parts record, until the licence is read on the original page. 2026-11-07: the live primary Thingiverse page was read in an ordinary browser without login or challenge bypass; the explicit Creative Commons link confirms CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. See docs/research/thingiverse-primary-licences-20261107.md for the exact asset, author, file list and limits. This supersedes the earlier access/licence conclusion, while preserving the historical notes. No model file was downloaded or imported; dimensions, units and fitment remain independently unverified. Secondary-page access dates are unchanged because those pages were not reread.
